# Package

The packages installed on the host.

## Where it is served

| Surface | Where |
| ------- | ----- |
| API | `/api/node/{hostname}/package`, in [API](/category/api) |
| CLI | `osapi client node package` |
| Jobs | `behavior.package.<method>`, run by the agent |

## Built on

| Uses | Used by |
| ---- | ------- |
| Nothing | Nothing |

## Where it runs

On `debian`, `linux`, `darwin`. On any other platform its methods report `skipped`.

`create` runs only on `debian`. On any other platform it reports `skipped`.

`delete` runs only on `debian`. On any other platform it reports `skipped`.

`create` runs `apt-get` with sudo, only where it runs.

`delete` runs `apt-get` with sudo, only where it runs.

On debian it also runs `dpkg-query`.

On darwin it also runs `brew`.

It runs `rpm` when the host has it, and reads without it otherwise.

In a trace, a call is the span `behavior.package.<method>`, with `exec apt-get`, `exec dpkg-query`, `exec brew`, `exec rpm` under it.

Its span records the input `name` (get, create, delete).

## Methods

| Method | Verb | Permission | Description |
| ------ | ---- | ---------- | ----------- |
| [`list`](../../usage/cli/client/node/package/list.md) | read | `package:read` | List the packages installed on the host |
| [`get`](../../usage/cli/client/node/package/get.md) | read | `package:read` | Get one installed package |
| [`create`](../../usage/cli/client/node/package/create.md) | write | `package:write` | Install a package |
| [`delete`](../../usage/cli/client/node/package/delete.md) | write | `package:write` | Remove a package |

## Settings

None. A behavior declares settings with `behavior.Config`.

## Inspecting it

```bash
osapi behavior get --name package                           # surfaces, methods, types, settings, telemetry
osapi behavior method get --name package --method <method>  # one method, with its JSON Schema
```
